name: Palm design and build delivery
description: Palm Living's planning-to-handover stage map. Approved planning evidence is carried into the delivery project at Procurement; On Hold remains a project condition.

stages.description: Confirm the project manager, delivery team and executable package plan from the released Deal File.
Coordinate the released concept and moodboard work without replacing approved revision history.
Coordinate room layouts and the accepted scope for each space.
Coordinate render work and its revision rounds against the approved design brief.
Record the client's decision on the exact design revision before downstream work proceeds.
Coordinate technical drawings against the accepted design revision.
Record selected materials and client sign-off before procurement.
Prepare measured quantities and costs against the approved design and material selections.
Manage purchase requirements, suppliers and evidence-backed commitments.
Confirm package readiness, approved production evidence and applicable finance gates.
Track factory work, inspection and dispatch evidence against released quantities.
Coordinate site readiness, execution, evidence and recovery actions.
Track accepted site receipts, installed quantities and inspections.
Close verified defects before client handover and finance closeout.
Keep the accepted project, package and aftercare history available as an auditable record.
